name: Synn
message: 「Do you understand? This is my house, and these vegetables are precious things I raised with lots of care」

name: Nanaka
message: 「So you can't just eat them without asking」

name: Lolotte
message: 「You have to properly say 'thank you for the meal' first」

name: Paqy
message: 「Yeah. Looks like it got the message, more or less」

name: Misa
message: 「Hey, Sakura. You need to be stricter with it. It doesn't look sorry at all」

name: Ria
message: 「Yeah... I just hope it stays quiet like this」
It's no wonder Senpai and Misa are worried. If only a Demon who can properly communicate its words and intentions would show up.

name: Paqy
message: 「Don't lump me in with small fry like this」

name: Lolotte
message: 「The mouth is the source of calamity and flavor, you know」
Parting ways like this would be the same as always. I have to try persuading the Demon from a different angle--

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, right. Do you guys want to play with fireworks together too?」

name: Synn
message: 「We really should have told her properly that it wasn't food」

name: Misa
message: 「I'm so dumbfounded I'm at a loss for words...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Come on! Let's light our fireworks too, fireworks!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Lolo-chan, gently bring the gunpowder tip close to the candle」

name: Misa
message: 「It's dangerous to point it at people. When you play with fireworks, point them where nobody is standing」

name: Paqy
message: 「You pulled a rotten stunt on me, I'll never forgive you for this!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「If we only had some tasty dango to go with this, it'd be the absolute best!」

name: Ria
message: 「If it's dango you want, I've got some. Here you go」

name: Synn
message: 「Senpai, why do you have those... Could you be a wizard?」

name: Ria
message: 「I was actually a witch all along, ahem!」

name: Misa
message: 「Senpai absolutely loves traditional Japanese sweets. She always keeps a stash on hand. You didn't even know that?」

name: Ria
message: 「Your reaction is way too dramatic, Synn-kun...」

name: Synn
message: 「Only the sparklers are left, I think?」

name: Ria
message: 「They're cute little fireworks that go mochimochi, sizzle, and plop」

name: Misa
message: 「Sakura-kun, let's have a contest to see whose lasts longer!!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ooh, sounds fun! Let's all do it together!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Not so fast. Mine hasn't gone out yet」

name: Paqy
message: 「Heh heh heh... Yours truly is number one!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hey...! Aaaah--you made me fall because of that weird noise...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well, I'm still number one, though. Ha-ha-ha!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I wondered why she hasn't said a word for a while, and she's super focused」

name: Paqy
message: 「Ria-chan, you're the best! Yeah, number one in the world!」

name: Misa
message: 「There were plenty of unexpected mishaps, but I'm glad it ended safely above all else」

name: Synn
message: 「Everyone really hyped things up, after all. It's a total triumph」

name: Lolotte
message: 「With all of you, I feel like we can accomplish anything!」

name: Misa
message: 「If you let it go to your head like that, you're going to slip up. There's no guarantee things will go this well next time」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Now, now. Just laugh it off and let it slide for today!」

name: Ria
message: 「That's right. He worked super hard for us, so a little bit is fine」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It's just like the saying, 'Even Kobo apologizes to his brush!' nanodesu」

name: Synn
message: 「Eh, eh? Did I do something wrong...?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Why are you making such a pathetic sound? Obviously I'm joking」

name: Synn
message: 「That's so mean, all of you ganging up on me!」

name: Misa
message: 「Actually, don't you have a guilty conscience about something?」

name: Ria
message: 「Heehee. To today's biggest MVP--thank you so much for all your hard work」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh... You're giving me this much today?!」

name: Ria
message: 「You worked even harder than usual, after all. It's a bonus, a boooonus♪」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well, I guess that wraps things up for today」

name: Synn
message: 「It's getting late, so why don't we all head back together? I'll walk you home」

name: Misa
message: 「You're the last person I ever want to owe a favor to」

name: Misa
message: 「Eh... Could it be just the two of us...\s04」

name: Misa
message: 「Wait, hold on. After dropping me off, Senpai will be all alone. That's way too dangerous!」

name: Misa
message: 「Ahh, my wavering heart. Whatever shall I do」

name: Riesling
message: 「Please leave the transportation of everyone to me, Riesling Tooyama」
Despite not wearing a cape, there was a sound like something fluttering, and Riesling appeared.
Without a sound, an expensive-looking car was parked on the narrow street.

name: Synn
message: 「That's a relief then. Does that work for you, Misa?」

name: Misa
message: 「Yes, of course. That way you won't have to tire yourself out either」

name: Misa
message: 「D-Don't get the wrong idea. It just means I don't need you as a bodyguard」

name: Lolotte
message: 「You're not very honest with yourself, are you, Vice President?」

name: Ria
message: 「Thank you for taking care of us, Jiiya-san」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Now then, everyone. Please step right inside」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah. It was super lively right up until just now, after all」

name: Synn
message: 「That really was fun~. Plus I got to eat some delicious food」

name: Paqy
message: 「Too bad you didn't get to eat any fatty tuna」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, yeah. Still, I got closer with everyone at today's welcome party, so I don't really mind」

name: Paqy
message: 「Heh heh heh... And pushing forward with your enslavement plan on top of that--just as expected of the Demon Lord」

name: Synn
message: 「Somehow, the whole fact that I'm the Demon Lord. I feel like I'm gonna end up forgetting it」

name: Paqy
message: 「You're free to forget, but you're the one who'll be in trouble later, Demon Lord」

name: Synn
message: 「Urgh, I won't give in to threats like that...!」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah. From here on out, there's gonna be more and more of them, right」

name: Paqy
message: 「Yeah. And then the world will be swallowed up in a vortex of terror」

name: Synn
message: 「Shooting stars pouring down across this whole sky. I bet it'll look amazing...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Heh heh heh... You really are a carefree guy」

name: Synn
message: 「Still, I can't afford to be too optimistic, either. After all, incidents are already happening right close to home」

name: Paqy
message: 「Right, right. The vegetables in the garden aren't gonna go back to normal, either」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, now that you mention it, that's true... I'd completely forgotten. Being with everyone was just so much fun--even if almost all our side dishes for the week are gone now」

name: Paqy
message: 「Heh heh heh... You're basking in the afterglow a bit too much, Demon Lord」

name: Synn
message: 「Demons come over by taking advantage of Re-Crea. As Student Council President--and a Crusader--I punish those demons and send them back to their own world」

name: Synn
message: 「Yet I always end up protecting them unconsciously. Wonder if my demon blood is acting up--always gotta be careful, bye-bye」

name: Synn
message: 「I just can't bring myself to hate them. I know all too well what it feels like to be hungry... and if I have the chance, I want to get along and share that feeling with them」

name: Paqy
message: 「Not all Demons come to the Human World just 'cause they're hungry, ya know」

name: Paqy
message: 「To dominate. To destroy. There are as many guys as stars in the sky who wanna disrupt the order, boiling over with desires that go way beyond appetite」

name: Paqy
message: 「Do you get it? You're saying you want to settle things peacefully even with guys like that, Lord Demon Lord」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm the Demon Lord--the king of the Demons, right...? If I am, then I at least want to lay down the law and make them listen」

name: Paqy
message: 「Then there's nothing to worry about! You just gotta go out and do it!」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, you're right! After all, a sparkling school life is waiting for me!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Heh heh heh... That's our Lord Demon Lord」
